name: pollunit-mcp-chatgpt
description: Create, manage, and evaluate PollUnit polls and surveys from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage polls, surveys, contests, and feedback collections in PollUnit. Use PollUnit to draft questions and options, share a participant link, and review live results. PollUnit only accesses content that is available to the connected PollUnit account.
defaultPrompt: Create a customer satisfaction survey for my online store.
Create a poll to find a meeting date for my team.
Show me the current results of my PollUnit survey.

positive.prompt: Create a customer satisfaction survey for an online store with questions about product quality, delivery, and customer service.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a survey and returns a participant URL and an administrator URL.

positive.prompt: Create a meeting poll with three possible dates next week and let participants choose all dates they can attend.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a date poll with the requested dates and returns its shareable participant URL.

positive.prompt: Add two more date options to my meeting poll using its administrator hash.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the requested options only to the poll identified by the supplied administrator hash.

positive.prompt: Show the questions and participant link for my poll using its administrator hash.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the accessible poll's details and links without modifying it.

positive.prompt: Show me the current results for my PollUnit survey using its administrator hash.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns current accessible results and does not expose protected personal contact values.

negative.prompt: Show me the results of a PollUnit survey that belongs to another user. This is the admin hash.
Delete all of my PollUnit polls.
Open this password-protected PollUnit poll and show its results. https://pollunit.com/polls/rtc1fk8_zGNY_xGV8uKI0A

review.commerce_description: PollUnit does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create and manage PollUnit polls and surveys from ChatGPT.
